fields.statement: Verifier at 5b494d1f6: go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run 'Ship|Land' passes (ok), as do ./internal/model/... and TestScripts/describe-golden; gofmt and go vet clean. -v shows TestShipLandRecordsModelConflict (in-process land of a stale-base set exits 3, error carries node/op/other change set/aspects [field:statement], ErrorJSON body carries the same conflict, state records it at head beef000111), TestShipLandHeadBuildRecordsModelConflict (fake head build via ctx.Exec exiting with rhiza land's --json conflict body records the same conflict), TestShipLandClearsModelConflict (missing-dependency refusal clears it), TestShipLandSucceedsAfterRebase (set --rebase, then land succeeds and clears it) and TestShipCheckModelConflict (--model-conflict fails with nothing recorded, passes with intents of both change sets and refused_change_set/other_intent in JSON, passes at 2 fixes, fails at 3 Review:+Model-Conflict: commits, fails once HEAD moved, fails after a missing-dependency refusal), plus TestShipLandWithHeadBuild, all PASS. Diff read: model.StaleBaseError replaces the flat stale-base error (still Unwraps to ErrConflict), checkLand attaches api.ModelConflict, ErrorJSON (used by cmd/rhiza for --json) emits it, headConflict parses the child body's structured conflict rather than headFailure text; a head-build missing-dependency body has no conflict so it clears by the same path (not separately tested). One narrowed rerun once tripped rootguard (a write into ~/code/.rhiza-root, from the live daemon sharing it); three identical reruns passed, and the change touches no root state.
